summary: A runtime-created mission's definition follows its canonically first claim's revision, so independent updates with different reasons converge however they arrive.

replay.detail: Incremental person-work projection now gives the definition the revision and source a full replay already gives: the canonically first claim's. A definition projected earlier from a later claim is corrected the next time that run tree is rebuilt or the graph is fully replayed; no new replay trigger is added.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or storage-version change.

rules.detail: Claim admission, person authority, idempotency keys, run state, checkpoint rules and revision history are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client schema or API change. A published mission's definition is never replaced by this path; only a definition of the same revision, or one another runtime-created run wrote, is.

downtime.detail: No restart or startup migration is required by the change.

manual.detail: No manual database repair or new operational command is required.

recovery.detail: The definition's revision and source change together inside the projecting transaction. Failure rolls both back; revision history rows are unchanged.
